bug_report:
ICE using module including boost headers
The following repro is a partial reduction of original code that was using boost.json, but at some point it became impossible to reduce further so this is a preprocessed repro from the point I'd got it down to.

There are two translation units:
- a module interface which includes boost code into its GMF and has an empty purview; this compiles successfully
- a regular translation unit which includes a std header, then imports the above module; this triggers an ICE

Command lines:

g++ -fPIC -Og -g -Wall -fmodules -std=c++2b -finput-charset=UTF-8 -o out/repro_module.a.gcm.o -c -x c++ -fpreprocessed -fdirectives-only repro_module.a.gcm.ii
g++ -fPIC -Og -g -Wall -fmodules -std=c++2b -finput-charset=UTF-8 -o out/repro_consumer.a.o -c -x c++ -fpreprocessed -fdirectives-only repro_consumer.a.o.ii
